item.description: ### Fixed - **Regenerate is now a real kill switch for a lost phone.** Regenerating the pairing secret used to rotate the connection key only — a phone that had paired before kept receiving background alerts and Live Activities (project, agent and activity text) for up to two weeks. It now forgets every registered phone and unregisters each with the relay before the new secret exists; a phone that is still yours simply pairs again. - **"Allow iPhone to connect" off now also stops pushes.** It used to close the connection and hide the push toggle while background pushes carried on.
